title: 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe
subtitle: Ch'u Yuan Feng Ho (Yeast Courtyard, Wind, and Lotus) · Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 21 boxes stand in this compound, 21 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 御製麴院風荷詩（圓明園四十景詩）
evidence.excerpt_zh:
乾隆九年 御製麴院風荷詩
西湖麴院為宋時酒務地荷花最多是有麴院風荷之名兹處紅衣印波長虹摇影風景相似故以其名名之
香逺風清誰解圖亭亭花底睡雙鳬停橈隄畔饒真賞那數餘杭西子湖
evidence.summary: The name comes from the place on 西湖 West Lake that was a Song state brewery, thick with lotus. This place, with red lotus and a long bridge's reflection, looks the same and takes the name.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 坐石臨流東南當碧桐書院正東為麴院風荷五楹南嚮其西佛樓為洛迦勝境（圓明園册）臣等謹按麴院風荷四十景之一額為皇上御書洛迦勝境額亦御書
evidence.summary: East of 碧桐書院: 麴院風荷, five bays facing south, with the Buddha tower 洛迦勝境 to its west.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 麴院風荷之南跨池東西橋九空坊楔二西為金鼇東為玉蝀金鼇西南河外室為四圍佳麗玉蝀東有亭為飲練長虹又東南度橋折而北設城闗為寧和鎮其東南為東樓門（圓明園册）臣等謹按飲練長虹寧和鎮諸額皆御書
evidence.summary: South of 麴院風荷, a nine-opening bridge across the pool with archways 金鼇 to the west and 玉蝀 to the east; 四圍佳麗 and the 飲練長虹 pavilion nearby; further south-east the walled mock town 寧和鎮 and the 東樓門.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷: 乾隆九年 poem of the Qianlong Emperor
evidence.date: 乾隆九年 (1744), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.256 item (1), under 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 香远风清谁解图，亭亭花底睡双凫。停桡堤畔饶真赏，那数余杭西子湖。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Qianlong Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1744. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆元年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆元年 (1796), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.257 item (2), under 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 显迹传东土，如来平等观。西方常住锡，南海永安澜。法律三车演，庄严七宝攒。长称圣人寿，普被福田宽。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1796, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷: 嘉庆七年 poem of the Jiaqing Emperor
evidence.date: 嘉庆七年 (1802), date from the compilation
evidence.locator: p.257 item (4), under 曲院风荷
evidence.excerpt_zh: 海南卓锡畅宗风，应感随声示现同。人我尽包四生转，慈悲原在一心通。六时钟磬真仍幻，三月莺花色即空。若向个中寻住脚，痴人说梦总愚蒙。
evidence.summary: Poem of the Jiaqing Emperor at 曲院风荷, 1802, on the view. Year as given by the compilation.

evidence.title: Scene 39, 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe
evidence.excerpt_other: The building at the Yuan Ming Yuan which bore this name faced south on a pretty lotus pond crossed by a great curved bridge supported by nine arches and leading nowhere in particular.
evidence.summary: Hall facing south on a lotus pond with a nine-arch curved bridge.

evidence.title: Site status table, about 2011: nothing visible, or built over
evidence.summary: Same table. In it the first group shows no visible remains; 得全阁, 流香渚, 凤麟洲, 涵秋馆, 蔚藻堂, 中和堂, 敷春堂 and 心镜轩 have service buildings on them, and 含晖楼, 澄心堂, 延寿寺, 清夏堂 and 喜雨山房 are occupied by other institutions. 澹泊宁静 and several others have been dug since, so this is out of date for them.

evidence.title: 圆明园百景史事分景汇编: 曲院风荷
evidence.locator: from p.256, under 曲院风荷
evidence.summary: 曲院风荷: 4 dated items, 1744-1802, of which 4 poems (Qianlong, Jiaqing); recurring themes: the view. First dated 1744, last dated 1802.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v3, editors' note on 曲院风荷
evidence.summary: Modelled on the West Lake scene. Five-bay hall, Buddhist tower 洛伽胜境, a nine-arch bridge with archways 金鳌 and 玉蝀, 四围佳丽, 饮练长虹, then 宁和镇, renamed 春和镇 early in Daoguang's reign to avoid a name taboo. West of it the village 村庄房.

evidence.title: 曲院风荷样式雷图
evidence.summary: Older record of a drawing of Quyuan Fenghe; the archived copy has a scene description only, no shelf number or date. No image here; the site may ask a small payment for the full record.

evidence.title: 圆明园曲苑风荷保护工程考古勘探报告
evidence.summary: Survey of a concave strip of about 13,500 m2 at 曲院风荷 Quyuan Fenghe, about 355 m north-south and 11-17 m wide, southwest of 福海. The printed figures do not multiply out to that area, so the area is doubtful. Results paywalled.
